High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Captain Rex, 501st Legion]] (Virtual Set 0, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 0/Light/Captain Rex 501st Legion.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPed2JoaFl2YVFfNFk/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Captain Rex 501st Legion.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,552 bytes, SHA-256 <code>c20a947ae2226f02c1ce1e68d7c3ec9c3450c890f406e8f3ecc92c362d01824d</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V0-L-captainrex501stlegion-2018-07-08.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
